description:
Mark an order as having no payment expected (e.g. a free / comp / sample order). Sets its payment status to "no payment". Use when an order should proceed without a recorded payment.

[#23c7f4]

order_uuid.description: The order uuid to mark as no-payment.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: mark_order_no_payment
